files.operations.sop:
@op.games.guess.start core.operation
    impl=start
    semantics=action
    action=guess.start
    doc="Starts a game: all animals of the knowledge base are candidates and the first question is chosen. Brings the guess tab forward."

@op.games.guess.answer core.operation
    impl=answer
    semantics=action
    action=guess.answer
    doc="Applies yes, no, dontknow or maybe to the current question or to the final guess and plans the next step."

@op.games.guess.correct core.operation
    impl=correct
    semantics=action
    action=guess.correct
    doc="The player corrects the previous answer (\"wait, I meant yes\"): the note of the last answered question changes, the candidates are recomputed and the next question is asked."

@op.games.guess.reveal core.operation
    impl=reveal
    semantics=action
    action=guess.reveal
    doc="The player says which animal it was; an unknown animal is learned as a session fact (kids.animals.animal, else games.guess.learned)."

@op.games.guess.giveUp core.operation
    impl=giveUp
    semantics=action
    action=guess.giveup
    doc="The system gives up and asks which animal it was."

@op.games.guess.hint core.operation
    impl=hint
    semantics=action
    action=guess.hint
    doc="There are no hints for the guesser; says so."

@op.games.guess.why core.operation
    impl=why
    semantics=action
    action=guess.why
    doc="Explains why the current question was chosen (how it splits the candidates)."

@op.games.guess.remaining core.operation
    impl=remaining
    semantics=action
    action=guess.remaining
    doc="Lists the candidates that are still possible."

@op.games.guess.count core.operation
    impl=count
    semantics=action
    action=guess.count
    doc="Tells how many questions were asked and are left."

@op.games.guess.repeat core.operation
    impl=repeat
    semantics=action
    action=guess.repeat
    doc="Repeats the current question or guess."

@op.games.guess.evidence core.operation
    impl=evidence
    semantics=action
    action=guess.evidence
    doc="A fact the player volunteers (it eats meat, it can swim, it has 4 legs, it lives in the sea) narrows the candidates like an answer without counting as a question."
